title: Detailed windmill
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='sky' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0' stop-color='#3a2a6b'/>
      <stop offset='1' stop-color='#6b4fa0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <g>
    <!-- ground -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='40' ry='6' fill='#4f7a3a'/>
    <rect x='10' y='88' width='80' height='8' fill='#3f6a2e'/>
    <!-- windmill body -->
    <polygon points='50,22 64,88 36,88' fill='#d9b26a'/>
    <polygon points='50,22 64,88 52,88' fill='#b8934f'/>
    <!-- door -->
    <path d='M44,88 L44,74 Q50,68 56,74 L56,88 Z' fill='#7a4a24'/>
    <path d='M50,71 L50,88' stroke='#5e3517' stroke-width='1.5'/>

    <rect x='47' y='46' width='6' height='8' rx='1' fill='#ffe27a'/>
    <path d='M50,46 L50,54 M47,50 L53,50' stroke='#b8934f' stroke-width='1'/>
    <!-- roof cap -->
    <polygon points='50,16 60,24 40,24' fill='#a84a2a'/>
    <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='2.5' fill='#ffe27a'/>
    <!-- blades -->
    <g transform='translate(50,28)'>
      <g>
        <g transform='rotate(0)'>
          <rect x='-1.6' y='-30' width='3.2' height='30' fill='#f2ead6'/>

          <rect x='1.6' y='-30' width='5.4' height='20' rx='1' fill='#e2d6bd'/>

          <line x1='1.6' y1='-14' x2='7' y2='-14' stroke='#c9b990' stroke-width='0.8'/>
          <line x1='1.6' y1='-22' x2='7' y2='-22' stroke='#c9b990' stroke-width='0.8'/>
        </g>
        <g transform='rotate(90)'>
          <rect x='-1.6' y='-30' width='3.2' height='30' fill='#f2ead6'/>

          <line x1='-7' y1='-20' x2='-1.6' y2='-20' stroke='#c9b990' stroke-width='0.8'/>
          <line x1='1.6' y1='-14' x2='7' y2='-14' stroke='#c9b990' stroke-width='0.8'/>
          <line x1='1.6' y1='-22' x2='7' y2='-22' stroke='#c9b990' stroke-width='0.8'/>
        </g>
        <g transform='rotate(180)'>
          <rect x='-1.6' y='-30' width='3.2' height='30' fill='#f2ead6'/>
          <rect x='-7' y='-30' width='5.4' height='20' rx='1' fill='#f7f2e8'/>

          <line x1='1.6' y1='-14' x2='7' y2='-14' stroke='#c9b990' stroke-width='0.8'/>
          <line x1='1.6' y1='-22' x2='7' y2='-22' stroke='#c9b990' stroke-width='0.8'/>
        </g>
        <g transform='rotate(270)'>
          <rect x='-1.6' y='-30' width='3.2' height='30' fill='#f2ead6'/>
          <rect x='-7' y='-30' width='5.4' height='20' rx='1' fill='#f7f2e8'/>
          <rect x='1.6' y='-30' width='5.4' height='20' rx='1' fill='#e2d6bd'/>

          <line x1='1.6' y1='-22' x2='7' y2='-22' stroke='#c9b990' stroke-width='0.8'/>
        </g>
      </g>
      <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='4' fill='#ffe27a'/>
      <circle cx='0' cy='0' r='1.6' fill='#a84a2a'/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
